name: dispatch_cli_or_workbench_start
description: Program entry point. It finds the current process and branches on whether it was started from the CLI or from Workbench. The Workbench path runs its setup and cleanup routines and returns, while the CLI path trims trailing spaces from the command line and passes it to the main routine.

name: close_libraries_and_reply
description: Cleanup handler that closes the library held in its first global slot when it is open, and when the second slot is set it forbids task switching and replies to the startup message. It returns its parameter unchanged.

name: call_two_library_functions
description: Calls two library functions through fixed negative offsets from the library base held in a register, one after the other, and returns nothing. The routine has no other logic.

name: open_dos_library_or_fail
description: Opens dos.library by name through the exec library. On success it returns the library base; on failure it raises an alert and returns the error code 100.

name: release_signal_device_library
description: Releases resources held in global slots, each only when its handle or flag is set: it frees a signal, closes a device and closes a library, then passes its incoming parameter to a final release call.

name: store_parameters_and_call_routines
description: Saves its two arguments into two global variables, then calls one routine with constant values and global addresses, and then calls a second routine with a single constant.

name: load_keymap_into_console
description: Gets a keymap name from the arguments or the icon tool types and lowercases it. It loads the matching file from the keymaps directory and sends it to the console device, reporting the usage and open-failure messages when a step fails.

name: forward_global_and_stack_buffer

name: call_indirect_table_entry

name: format_message_and_output

name: setup_library_calls_with_flags
description: Stores a byte value combined with 99 into a global, then makes a long sequence of library calls at fixed offsets, routing each call through a pointer when one is set.

name: compute_scaled_difference_value
description: Computes a 16-bit value from the difference of two fields: when a counter is at least two it divides a weighted difference by three for small counters or shifts a weighted difference right by two otherwise; below two it halves the plain difference.

name: init_four_word_record
description: Stores zero into the first and third fields of a four-field record, a fixed constant into the second and zero into the fourth.

name: decrement_counters_wrap_by_two
description: Decrements each of ten 16-bit counters, adding two back when a counter goes negative, then points a link field at a fixed offset inside the same structure.

name: init_five_field_from_table
description: Stores a value from a fixed constant table and values derived from a counter plus one into a five-field record.

name: clear_twenty_two_bytes
description: Writes zero to 22 consecutive bytes starting at the given pointer, then returns.

name: copy_text_lines_until_bar
description: Copies characters from a source text into a buffer row by row, ending each row at a vertical bar character and stopping when the row or character counter runs out.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Does nothing: the decompiled body is a bare return, so the routine has no behaviour of its own here.

name: reply_pending_port_messages
description: Calls a library routine, then checks two stored fields and, when they are set, calls further routines to reply to the pending message and clear them.

name: compare_two_records_by_value
description: Compares two records by a signed 16-bit field, then by a 32-bit value and a 16-bit tie-break, and returns the first record's value when it orders first.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Does nothing: the decompiled body is a bare return, so the routine has no behaviour of its own here.

name: store_value_and_minus_four
description: Stores its register argument into the first long word of a record and the constant minus four into the following 16-bit field.

name: call_stored_library_function
description: Calls one library function at a fixed offset from a library base read from a global variable, then returns.

name: copy_string_into_buffer
description: Stores a call result into a structure field, then copies a zero-terminated string into a fixed buffer and appends a zero terminator.

name: scale_value_by_exponent
description: Shifts a 64-bit fixed-point value right or left by an amount derived from a 16-bit exponent field; values below a threshold pass through unchanged.

name: call_get_msg_routine
description: Calls the exec GetMsg function through a library base read from a global variable, then returns.

name: process_sixteen_pending_entries
description: Loops over sixteen table entries, and for each non-zero one calls a routine with the entry's two stored values when the first routine returns true.

name: call_stored_library_function
description: Calls one library function at a fixed offset from a library base read from a global variable, then returns.

name: store_result_and_call_library
description: Stores a routine result into two fields of a record and then calls a library function at a fixed offset.

name: pack_args_and_check_size
description: Stores its register arguments in a stack record, calls a routine to get a size, and returns that size rounded up to an even value; for sizes in a set range it makes a further call.

name: pack_args_and_check_size
description: Stores its register arguments in a stack record, calls a routine to get a size, and makes a further call for sizes in a set range before returning the size.

name: remove_port_and_free_memory
description: Calls one routine, then removes a message port through the exec library and frees a memory block through a function pointer.

name: reset_slot_table_minus_one
description: Clears one long field, sets two 16-bit fields to fixed values, then fills eight long words in a table with minus one and stores a further constant.

name: call_routine_then_library_function
description: Calls a routine and then calls a library function at a fixed offset from a library base read from a global variable.

name: call_routine_then_library_function
description: Calls a routine and then calls a library function at a fixed offset from a library base read from a global variable.

name: call_routine_then_library_function
description: Calls a routine and then calls a library function at a fixed offset from a library base read from a global variable.

name: set_flag_byte_from_result
description: Calls one routine and stores eight into a flag byte when its result is non-zero, otherwise zero.

name: compare_register_pairs_for_match
description: Compares two pairs of register arguments; it returns zero when they match and minus one when any pair differs.

name: update_table_entry_and_scan
description: Writes a constant into a table entry and increments a neighbouring byte, then runs a loop of table lookups; the decompiler did not fully recover the loop.

name: update_table_entry_and_scan
description: Writes the input byte into a table entry and increments a neighbouring byte, then runs a loop of table lookups; the decompiler did not fully recover the loop.

name: reset_byte_and_word_fields
description: Clears one byte field and sets a 16-bit field in the same record to minus four.
